entries.summary: Design and settings CSS compile into #cmsBuilderLiveCss (and public style.cms-layout-css) instead of rebuilding the canvas; width/valign/hide patch classes in place. Node hook class cms-el-{id}.
No schema change. Compiled CSS is derived at render from layout_json; not a new column.
cms-builder-drag-column-size.spec.ts asserts min-height in #cmsBuilderLiveCss and public style.cms-layout-css instead of inline style attributes.
